bare-wire.fix: Make the heal readable at 120px: let the scar disc peak at scale .95 (reach the crema edge) and hold opacity 1 from 20% to 85% of the beat, delay the heal disc start from 12% to 35%, and give the heal disc a 1px darker rim via a fill-only second circle (r slightly larger, behind it) so a dark ring visibly closes inward each second. Keep all of it transform/opacity on filled circles. Also replace the pasted second SVG with one <symbol> + <use> (or a single instance resized by container) to halve the markup.
bare-wire.keep: Six filled shapes animating only transform/opacity on a 1s beat that divides 5s, with the scar fading to opacity 0 before the wrap so the loop closes with no seam.

warm-hands.fix: Move the 360deg sweep off the SVG child group: split into two stacked layers (static cup/rim/handle/stain SVG, and a second SVG or div holding only the spiral + tip + bloom) and put animation:sweep with will-change:transform on that HTML/SVG root element, with sway nested inside it, so the rotation is composited and the cup never repaints. Drop will-change from .bloom and let opacity live on the layer root too.
warm-hands.keep: One 5s period for every animated property, linear sweep with zero-slope sway and opacity so frame 5.0 equals frame 0.0 with matching velocity.

the-glitch.fix: Remove the hard cuts in the drop keyframes (55% to 55.2% opacity 1 to 0 snap, then teleport back up): let the drop squash (scaleY .5, scaleX 1.3) and fade 55% to 65% into the ring, then fade in at the spout from scale .3 over 0-8%, all eased; and cut --slip to 4px with the slip curve starting after the 3s landing, so the one purposeful hitch is the only abrupt thing in the loop.
the-glitch.keep: The countable 1s drop-and-pip beat that divides the 5s cycle exactly, with the gravity-eased fall.
